description: PETSc-based finite element assembly and solver utilities. Requires petsc4py. Objects must be manually destroyed with .destroy().
important_notes: PETSc objects (Mat, Vec, KSP, SNES) must be manually destroyed by calling .destroy() to avoid memory leaks.
This module wraps petsc4py for seamless integration with DOLFINx.
